description: Interior design packages: Express €20/m², Basic €35–45/m², Furniture €35–50/m², Premium €50/m², Premium+ €70/m². Bratislava and Vienna, free consultation.
h1: Interior design prices in Bratislava and Vienna

blocks.text: Interior design prices in Bratislava and Vienna

parts.html: Five packages — from a quick 3D concept to a project with design supervision during the renovation. Choose the one that suits your property and your goals.

blocks.text: The “Express” interior design package — €20/m² Completion time — from 14 days after the layout is approved

parts.html: A quick concept for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are already ready for finishing and don’t need a full set of working drawings.
Includes a measured floor plan, a furniture layout plan, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of each main room with one full round of revisions. Electrical design is charged separately.
You see the layout, materials, furniture, lighting, and color before finishing work even begins.
Price: €20/m²
Minimum package price: €1,500
The “Furniture” interior design package — €35–50/m²

For apartments, houses, and commercial spaces that are ready to be furnished. Includes a measured floor plan, a furniture layout plan, photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with one full round of revisions, and a complete set of furniture drawings for manufacturing custom furniture.
You receive a finished interior concept and a technical brief for manufacturing custom kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, and other cabinet furniture.
Price: €35–50/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000
We can make the furniture for this project in our own workshop, then deliver and install it.

items.text: Project example: Metropolis residential complex, Bratislava, 75 m²
Project example: Eurovea City residential complex, Bratislava, 56 m²

parts.html: A complete design project for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces before renovation: 3D visualization and a set of working drawings for the construction crew.

Includes a measured floor plan, a furniture layout plan, demolition and construction plans, plans for plumbing, underfloor heating, outlets and electrical connection points, switches, lighting, ceilings, and floors, wall elevations for the kitchen and bathrooms, and finishing material specifications and schedules.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with one full round of revisions.
Price: €35–45/m²
Minimum package price: €2,000
Design supervision, a detailed renovation cost estimate, furnishing and procurement, custom furniture manufacturing, and turnkey renovation are available as add-ons.

items.text: View an example of a project with technical documentation

parts.html: The most detailed project for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces, with the designer’s support as you prepare for the renovation.

Includes the full basic set of working drawings, wall elevations for every room, detail drawings and sections, specifications and quantity calculations for the main materials, and photorealistic 3D visualizations of each room with up to two full rounds of revisions.
Plus two material-selection trips with the designer.
Price: €50/m²
Minimum package price: €2,500
Our most comprehensive package: a thoroughly detailed project and the designer’s support during implementation.
Includes everything in the “Premium” package, plus 2 months of design supervision, furniture drawings, complete finishing material specifications, and schedules for all interior items.
Price: €70/m²
Minimum package price: €3,500
Design supervision can be ordered separately with any package:
The designer advises the crew, clarifies details, and checks that the work on site follows the design.
If you are not sure which package you need, come for a free consultation: we’ll suggest the right one based on the floor area and goals for your property.
